description: Before writing or changing code that calls a third-party npm package, call this to learn which of its APIs changed after your training cutoff: removed or renamed exports, new required parameters, removed options, deprecations with replacements, and breaking changelog entries. Pass the version the project pins (from package.json or the lockfile) when you know it.

apis.description: Exports you are about to use, to rank changes to them first

cutoff.description: Training cutoff (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) to use instead of a model id.

model.description: Your own model id (e.g. claude-opus-5-5). Defaults to the model configured in the coding agent's settings.

version.description: Version or range the project uses (default: latest)

name: package_changes
title: What changed in a package since my training data
